note: DATA_UPG_B literature scan, 2026-11-08 16:11-16:45 UTC (access times per entry are approximate within this window). Read-only: WebSearch/WebFetch only; PDF reports were read via WebFetch (the tool cached the PDF bytes in the session tool-results folder) and their text extracted locally with pypdf for quoting; no Excel/CSV dataset downloaded. Grades: VERIFIED = quote and number read in the source text; SNIPPET = only seen in a search-engine summary; NOT_READ = source not readable (403/404/429/paywall/dataset). 'value' fields keep source units; any converted number is marked 'derived'. Conversion used in derived numbers: gasoline 8.9 kWh/L (ITDP E06); diesel about 10 kWh/L is an assumption of this note, not a source value. Brief check: PyPSA-Eur 53.19 x100 km per MWh_el = 18.80 kWh/100 km (not 1.880), 16.0712 x100 km per MWh_oil = 62.22 kWh/100 km (not 6.222); ratio 3.31 unchanged. Key name in v2025.07.0 is transport_ice_efficiency (no key transport_internal_combustion_efficiency). Local text extracts used for quoting: scratchpad/lit/*_text.txt.
